datasheet.title: 7050X4 Series 100/200/400G Data Center Switches Data Sheet (Arista Networks, 03-0057-27, Aug 27th, 2025)

description: Arista 7050PX4-32S - a fixed 1RU data-centre switch with 32 x 400G OSFP ports and 2 x SFP+ ports, running EOS. The front carries the OSFP cages in two stacked rows, the odd number on top, in four blocks of four columns separated by rails, with the two SFP+ cages stacked at the right. Four system lamps (system, fan, PS1, PS2) are at the far right. The rear carries two hot-swap power supplies at the ends, three hot-swap fan modules, and the RJ-45 management port, the USB port and the RJ-45 console port. The same panel is ordered with front-to-rear air (-F) or rear-to-front air (-R).

name: 7050px4-32s

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 52.7 cm (19 x 1.75 x 20.7 inches), 12.1 kg (26.6 lbs). Data sheet: 43.9 x 4.45 x 52.65 cm (17.3 x 1.75 x 20.72 in), 26.6 lbs (12.1 kg). The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.9 cm, 440.0 here. The height is 43.7, as the other 1RU models (the guide prints 4.4 cm and 1.75 in, the data sheet 4.45 cm, so both print 44.5 mm for this model; the figure's own aspect, 828 x 82 px, is 10.1 and matches 439.9 / 43.7 = 10.07, where 44.5 would give 9.89, so the figure was preferred over the printed 44.5 mm). The depth is the guide's 52.7 cm (527.0); the data sheet's 52.65 cm differs by half a millimetre, a rounding. 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the median of bare-plate pixels in the guide's figure C-2.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7050PX4-32S-F and -R ("front-to-rear air, 2xAC" and "rear-to-front air, 2xAC"). The "#" SKU ("configurable fans and psu") is an order of parts, not a part number a DCIM can hold. The data sheet lists no DC SKU: the DC configurations are examples with no part number.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED, as arista/7050dx4-32s: the guide's rack-mounting figures are isometric and carry no measure, and the kit guides are not held. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: storage -40 to 70 C, the rest the same. The storage temperature differs: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The vertical model legend reads "7050PX4-32S" up the left plate beside a ribbed tab (callout 7, "Tab", a pull tab 6.5 to 10.5 mm across and 13.3 to 39.9 mm down). The maker's wordmark above the first column from 1.2 to 16.3 mm across IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it and the plain model text is set.

front-ports.note: Figure C-2 at 1.882 px/mm anchored on the 440 mm body, tab centres from a pixel scan. Thirty-two OSFP cages (ports 1 to 32) in two stacked rows and sixteen columns, in four blocks of four columns. The tab centres of the first block run from 49.0 px at a pitch of 43.7 px, 23.22 mm, so the cage centre of column 1 is 25.8 mm from the left of the body; each block after it starts 7.0 mm further on than the pitch gives (the rail between blocks), so column 16 is 395.1 mm. The cages are 23.1 mm wide and 13.5 mm tall (std/osfp). The top row centres 14.8 mm and the bottom row 34.6 mm below the top, a row pitch of 19.8 mm. Two SFP+ cages (33 over 34) sit at the right, centred 421.4 mm from the left, on a 13.2 mm pitch like the other 7050X4 models'. The OSFP rows are both turned 0, the library's convention for a stacked OSFP pair (lint L108, OSFP MSA rev 5.22 section 7.1: a stacked cage seats both modules the same way up); the lower SFP+ cage is turned 180. The figure is too small to show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E and the data sheet ("1+1 hot-swappable"): THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE THREE FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit. The guide draws no blank for an empty bay, so none is modelled. The management block, the USB port and the console port are placements.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-2 passes at 0.5 percent. The raster is 844 x 197 pixels. The body between its plate edges measures 828 px wide and 82 px tall (aspect 10.1), against the data sheet's 439.9 / 43.7 = 10.07, so the figure is near-orthographic and carries geometry at 1.882 px/mm (the 440 mm body is the scale anchor). One pixel is 0.53 mm, so every front position is good to about 0.5 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The cage columns were read from the white port-number tabs by their centres.

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s: the same three-fan 1RU rear, positions as arista/7280cr3-32d4's within two millimetres. The guide draws the rear generically and does not say which model uses which. The 7050PX4-32S is mapped to D-1 by its three fan modules (data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)"), its 1RU height and its two power supplies. THE MAPPING IS ESTIMATED.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-22 for an end-of-sale notice for the 7050PX4-32S on Arista's advisories and notices pages. No notice was found.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis (guide section 4.2, Table 5, KIT-GND-EXT-1RU); no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2, Table 10: off the link is down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics. Figure C-2 draws small green dots along the top edge above the cages, two to a column, and none that resolve at the lower edge; ONE LAMP A PORT is modelled, the odd port's at the left and the even port's at the right of its column, both along the top. The SFP+ lamps sit at the left of the 33 and 34 cages, as in figure C-1.

port-numbering.note: Figure C-2 (callout 1, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on across, 1 to 32, then 33 over 34 at the right. The odd number is the upper cage. The figure prints each number on a white tab over its cage and, smaller, in blue in the orange speed strip, "1" with an up arrow at the strip's left and "2" with a down arrow at its right. The numerals are set in the strip. EOS interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4: typical / maximum 353 W / 880 W with PWR-1512-AC or PWR-1511-DC; the data sheet states the same, typical "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers".

rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s: PS1 left and PS2 right, supplies 73.5 mm wide at 4.0 and 362.3 mm across, the management block 83.0 to 101.0 mm across, three fan modules 78.6 mm wide at 107.7, 191.0 and 274.3 mm.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet: "Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)", "Fan Tray FAN-7011H -F/R" for the 7050PX4-32S, FAN-7011H-F and -R as spares. The three fan modules are bays that accept FAN-7011H-F or -R; the -R configurations seat the blue modules.

No drawing, photograph or logo is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings.

speed-strips.note: Figure C-2 draws an orange strip under each column of two OSFP cages, between the rows, with a printed legend in its middle (the first reads 400G; the rest are unreadable at this resolution). The sixteen strips are drawn at 23.8 to 26.3 mm down and their legends are not drawn. A navy strip between the SFP+ cages reads 10G in the figure and is drawn without its legend.

status-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.1, Table 9 and Figure C-2 callouts 2 to 5: a system status lamp, a fan status lamp and a status lamp for each of the two power supplies, as arista/7050dx4-32s. Four lamps in a column at the far right, 433.7 mm across and 7.9, 11.3, 14.8 and 18.1 mm down; the order is the order of the guide's Figure A-1.

vents.note: The figure shows a perforated band above the cages (0.8 to 5.2 mm down) with a round knob in it at about 110 mm and another at about 309 mm. Drawn as a vent field in its measured extent; the individual squares and the knobs are not drawn.
